title: Undaunted: Stalingrad
subtitle: The 2-Player Persistent Tactical WWII Campaign
tagline: Command opposing platoons through the brutal meat grinder of Stalingrad across 15+ branching persistent scenarios.
loreSummary: Autumn 1942. You and your rival commander command Soviet defenders or German assault forces in the pulverized ruins of Stalingrad. In this standalone head-to-head campaign, every casualty is recorded permanently with casualty stickers, individual squad members gain heroic upgrades or die forever, buildings are permanently leveled, and the tactical map bears the scars of war.
keyFeatures: Dedicated 2-player persistent tactical campaign with branching storylines and consequences
Permanent casualty and squad modification stickers transforming your combat deck
Dynamic city map tiles permanently degraded into smoking rubble as artillery strikes land
Over 300 unique illustrations bringing historical WWII platoon members to life

undaunted_stalingrad_extended_attrition.description: An exhaustive war of attrition campaign resolving extended stalemates, sewer warfare, and deep operational branches.
